state: November 28 reviewed local candidate: 42 domain tests, 9 actual-browser IndexedDB checks and scoped UI observations passed; partial, unverified and deferred scope remains explicit.

cases.when: Valid fields
cases.expected: New unique ID and Needs review; never auto-approved
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. The actual UI created the later matching request with its own ID, retaining both records without auto-approval; see docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json.

cases.when: Unit empty or whitespace
cases.expected: Needs information; no approval
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. DEMO-002 with missing unit was blocked; saving unit 3 produced revision 2 and approval produced revision 3. See docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json: missing_information_and_approval.

cases.when: Sample rule matches description
cases.expected: Rule ID and priority suggestion shown; human approval required
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. The sample-leak test verifies rule identity, priority and required review; UI source renders the explanation. A targeted sample-leak UI flow was not rerun in the November 28 inspector journey.

cases.when: Normalized address/unit/category match
cases.expected: Flag both; count unchanged
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. The later matching request was flagged and both records remained; see docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json: later_duplicate_invalidates_approval.

cases.when: Category absent from catalog
cases.expected: Out of scope; unsent draft only
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. Unsupported categories are retained and cannot be approved. This does not claim a new November 28 UI interaction for that fixture.

cases.when: Change value with reason
cases.expected: New version and before/after history
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. Priority changes with reasons create a revision, retain before/after history and expire existing approval.

cases.when: Empty reason
cases.expected: Reject without mutation
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. Empty or nonmeaningful decision reasons are rejected without mutation.

cases.when: Commit then reload
cases.expected: Same fields, flags, version and history
cases.evidence: docs/evidence/browser-checks-2026-11-28.json: Approved state survives close and reopen. The earlier November 25 walkthrough also observed UI reload persistence; that is historical UI evidence.

cases.when: Transaction aborts
cases.expected: Store unchanged; draft retained; no Saved claim
cases.evidence: docs/evidence/browser-checks-2026-11-28.json proves thrown-failure and actual-abort rollback. The November 28 UI retained a dirty draft after a stale-revision conflict, and the November 25 UI retained one after NOT_FOUND. Injected storage-failure UI behavior remains unverified.

cases.when: Expected version older than current
cases.expected: Reject conflict, no lost update
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. docs/evidence/browser-checks-2026-11-28.json rejects stale writes. The November 28 cross-tab UI rejected the old-base save and retained its draft; see docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json: cross_tab_saved_refresh.

cases.when: Text contains script or image event
cases.expected: Display inert text
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. Comparison/history/export tests keep HTML and formula-like content literal; UI rendering uses text nodes. An active browser payload check remains unverified.

cases.when: Malformed JSON or invalid schema
cases.expected: Reject atomically
cases.deferred_reason: General JSON import is not included in the first working slice.

cases.when: Persisted browser data has an unknown newer schema version
cases.expected: Reject opening the incompatible data without erasing or rewriting it
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. docs/evidence/browser-checks-2026-11-28.json: Future schema data remains untouched.

cases.when: Change approved field
cases.expected: New saved revision requires review; old approval snapshot remains immutable; current record cannot be exported until reapproved
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. The real UI save advanced approved 3 to saved 4, broke the seal and retained approval 3; see docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json: saved_edit_breaks_approval.

cases.when: Cell starts with =,+,-,@ or control chars
cases.expected: Neutralize formula and escape field
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. Formula/control-prefix handling is verified in the domain; stored instructions remain unchanged.

cases.when: Commas quotes and newlines
cases.expected: Valid round-trippable CSV
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. CSV round-trips commas, quotes, Unicode and multiline instructions.

cases.when: Mix current approved, incomplete, unresolved and edited formerly approved records
cases.expected: Export only complete and resolved current saved revisions with matching approval; include exact approved instructions and revision
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. The UI exported only the current eligible approval after reapproval and preview refresh; see docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json: actual_csv_download.

cases.when: Complete workflow without pointer
cases.expected: Visible focus, reachable controls, managed dialog focus
cases.evidence: docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json: historical_selector_readonly verifies native keyboard selection and focus retention on November 28. A creation-to-approval Tab/Enter path was observed November 25. Broader dialogs, export and assistive-technology coverage remain unverified.

cases.when: 360px viewport and 200% zoom
cases.expected: No clipped primary controls or horizontal page overflow
cases.evidence: docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json: narrow_comparison_layout records a 360 CSS-pixel iframe, document client/scroll widths 345/345, comparison bounding/scroll widths 285/283, stacked side labels and a wrapping long UUID. Actual 200% zoom and physical-device testing remain unverified.

cases.when: OS preference enabled
cases.expected: No decorative animation; no loss of state information
cases.evidence: CSS preference support is present. Preference-specific browser verification has not been run.

cases.when: Preview an approved revision, then edit it before downloading
cases.expected: Block the stale selection; identify the changed request and require an updated preview; never export its old approval as current
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. docs/evidence/browser-checks-2026-11-28.json verifies persisted-state checks. A real stale download was blocked in the November 28 UI; see docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json: actual_stale_download.

cases.when: Approve A, then create or edit B to match A address, unit and category
cases.expected: Atomically add unresolved duplicate conditions, advance affected revisions, invalidate approvals and append history; preserve both records
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. Adding REQ-57263399-ce4c-4008-8cda-47e7ebb25825 advanced DEMO-002 to 6 and invalidated approval while retaining both records; see docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json.

cases.when: Resolve A/C with a reason, approve A, then introduce new matching B
cases.expected: The A/C reason does not resolve A/B; A requires review and cannot be exported
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. A new third matching request does not inherit an earlier pair reason. The earlier November 25 UI regression observed this three-request case; the November 28 UI observed a new counterpart and its separate recorded resolution.

cases.when: Abort a transaction that would introduce a duplicate on an approved request
cases.expected: All affected records, revisions, approvals and histories remain at their prior committed values; keep the attempted draft unsaved
cases.evidence: docs/evidence/browser-checks-2026-11-28.json verifies all-record rollback for thrown and aborted transactions. Retaining the attempted draft during an injected UI storage failure remains unverified; the observed UI conflict path is different.

cases.when: Retry the same user intent after a failed transaction
cases.expected: Commit each intended state transition and history event once; no duplicated records or events
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. docs/evidence/browser-checks-2026-11-28.json: thrown-failure rollback and retry verify one committed transition without duplicate history.

cases.when: Attempt to approve or export while relevant visible fields are unsaved
cases.expected: Require a successful save and review of that saved revision; do not imply unsaved values were approved or exported
cases.evidence: docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json: unsaved_draft_is_distinct and cross_tab_status_repeat_after_fix verify disabled approval/export controls, the explicit draft note and current saved status.

cases.when: Create a record in the empty workspace, then reset the synthetic demonstration
cases.expected: Only demo records reset; user workspace data and approval history remain unchanged
cases.evidence: docs/evidence/browser-checks-2026-11-28.json: Demo reset preserves the separate user workspace.

cases.when: Approve a revision with specific instructions, download CSV and reload
cases.expected: Downloaded instructions, request ID, approved revision and approval time correspond to the saved approval; reloaded history retains the snapshot
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. Approved storage survives close/reopen in docs/evidence/browser-checks-2026-11-28.json. The real November 28 CSV is docs/evidence/approved-revision-2026-11-28.csv; its single row matches approved DEMO-002 revision 5 at 2026-11-28T06:48:02.361Z.

cases.when: A request has a current approval and one or more preserved approvals
cases.expected: List every approval once with stable identity; preserve the selected approval across saved updates
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json: historical_selector_readonly and cross_tab_status_repeat_after_fix.

cases.when: Select another approval or inspect returned comparison data
cases.expected: Do not mutate saved records, history, current approval or export eligibility
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. Frozen-input/returned-data tests passed. Native selector changes did not mutate history or approval state in docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json.

cases.when: Visible editor fields are unsaved
cases.expected: Show an immediate draft note and compare the selected approval with the current saved record
cases.evidence: docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json: unsaved_draft_is_distinct, cross_tab_saved_refresh and discard_restores_current.

cases.when: A condition is added, removed or changed relative to a selected approval
cases.expected: Keep each side exact, show absence explicitly, and retain its recorded resolution details
cases.evidence: tests/domain.test.js; 42 tests passed on November 28. Added/removed/modified condition cases passed. The UI observed an absent earlier side and the current resolved duplicate with its actual reason in docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json: condition_absence_and_resolution; removal and both-resolved modification are domain coverage, not additional claimed UI runs.

cases.when: Another tab saves while the selected request has an unsaved draft
cases.expected: Refresh comparison from current saved state, retain selected approval, draft base and focus, and reject stale saves
cases.evidence: docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json: cross_tab_saved_refresh verified saved 9 with the old-base draft; the repeated final check retained approval-3 selection at saved 11.

cases.when: Another tab invalidates approval while the local draft remains unsaved
cases.expected: Clearly distinguish the draft base from latest saved revision and refresh saved-status text and seal without replacing draft fields
cases.evidence: docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json: cross_tab_status_repeat_after_fix verified draft base 10 / saved 11, Needs review, Save or discard draft and the broken revision-11 seal.

cases.when: The comparison is displayed in a 360 CSS-pixel embedded viewport
cases.expected: Identify approved/current revision on each stacked side, show literal change status, wrap long IDs and avoid horizontal document overflow
cases.evidence: docs/evidence/ui-checks-2026-11-28.json: narrow_comparison_layout and layout_measurements. This scoped pass does not include 200% zoom or a physical-device check.

verification_summary.scope_note: Verification layers are stated per case. A passing domain or repository check does not imply an unobserved UI path. Unverified product checks are not automatically mandatory contest requirements.
